scope: Observed current local P39 source APIs. No new P40 code, artwork, review approval or live behavior is established by these notes.

assets.optionalURL: Allows deduplicated raw SHA path while preserving logical assets/frame paths.

indexContract.sourceURLPolicy: same-origin or HTTPS raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/repository/40hexcommit/path; no credentials,query,fragment,redirect. No mutable remote branch or tag URL.
indexContract.composition: Clone prior index, preserve all prior entries; append exact reviewed entry only once, call CQC_NATIVE_WARDROBE.configureIndex(next).
indexContract.pixelPipeline: Pinned CORS fetch -> exact byte count and SHA256 -> PNG signature/IHDR dimensions -> Blob -> native Image decode -> guarded selection commit.

metadataContract.nativeDirections: Both actions/oppositeActions, mirror false; different PNG sources or disjoint measured native regions. No original-body source reuse.
metadataContract.scaling: sprite.displayHeight / sourceFrameHeights[frame.file], else baseFrameHeight, else frame.rect height. source heights must be positive finite; raw renderer imposes no canvas-height cap. Preview stature and body datum are independent measured fields.

selectedNativeSocketContract.existingEligibility: pass21Revision /^native-(?:retro|nextgen|tuxedo|cyborg-mgr)-v1$/ only; canonical outfits are not eligible under this guard.
selectedNativeSocketContract.points: frameFraction must equal nativeXY within .05px; active source frame must have matching attachment.
selectedNativeSocketContract.warning: Existing installer delegates prior projectile origin when new helper returns null. Therefore missing actual-profile ports can fall back to historical origins. Native PNG strictness does not prove no origin fallback. A canonical P40 wrapper must remain scoped to admitted UID/costume, match selected source frames, and be separately tested for all emitted move kinds and both facings.

restoredCompilerApplicability.integration/compile-reviewed-dlc.mjs: Hardcoded Raiden MGR four DLC entries and private source paths. Reference only; cannot compile Soviet Woodland unchanged.
restoredCompilerApplicability.integration/prepare-metadata.py: Hardcoded Raiden refs, geometry and mappings and writes its own historical audit; do not run or reuse historical approval.
restoredCompilerApplicability.solid-gala/validate-and-compile.mjs: Shows actual validator execution, unchanged engine/timing comparisons, SHA audit binding and native selected-source emission checks, but hardcoded Solid Gala.
restoredCompilerApplicability.solid-gala/index.template.js: Small compose/strict-preview example; hardcoded UID/assets and old path literals.
restoredCompilerApplicability.integration/native_geometry.py: Read-only source mask -> exact native contour with pixel-center containment proof; never writes PNGs.

bootQualification: core__snake base-catalog entry alone is not authoritative final runtime profile: later fidelity/gameplay modules can overwrite kits or phase mapping. Recover actual complete host boot order and inspect final runtime before binding projectile tags/active phases.
